In modular arithmetic, reduce at every step. Multiplying two enormous numbers and taking the remainder at the end works, but it takes ten times longer and it fails. Reducing after each operation always leaves small numbers.
<strong>Para probar que algo es numerabl: To prove something is countable, build the list. It is not enough to say they “seem” to fit: you have to give the bijection, even if it is the zigzag or the diagonal. That is what gets marked.
<strong>Un contraejemplo vale tanto como: A counterexample is worth as much as a proof. In questions about groups or about completeness, finding one case that fails settles the matter in a line.
<strong>«No computable» no significa «di: “Not computable” does not mean “hard”. It means no algorithm solves it for every input. Wording that carefully is where the marks are in the last questions.
Aritmética modular, inverso y teorema ch: Modular arithmetic, inverses and the Chinese remainder theorem; Fermat's little theorem; checking the group axioms and finding the order of an element; adding points on an elliptic curve and using Diffie-Hellman.

Cuando Cantor publicó que había infinito: When Cantor published that there were infinities of different sizes, Kronecker —who had been his teacher— blocked his publications and his posts for years, and Cantor spent the rest of his life in and out of sanatoria. Hilbert settled the argument in 1926 with a sentence: “No one shall expel us from the paradise that Cantor has created for us.” The exercises in the second section are the arithmetic of that paradise.

El enlace de un examen corregido reprodu: The link to a marked exam reproduces the same questions with the same numbers. A teacher can do one, copy the link and pass it to the class: everyone will sit the same exam and will be able to compare results and procedures.
Elige los tramos que entran. Las pregunt: Choose the sections to include. Eso es la densidad, y no tiene nada que: That is density, and it has nothing to do with cardinality: the reals are dense too and they are not countable.

Numerable significa que existe una biyec: Countable means there is a bijection with the naturals, and a list that reaches them all is that bijection. The diagonal sweep, skipping equivalent fractions, is the usual construction.
Seis temas sobre lo que tienen en común: Six topics about what mathematical objects have in common and about what it means to count the uncountable. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. Te piden demostrar que el conjunto de lo: You are asked to prove that the set of rational numbers is countable. What is enough to do?
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 6 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
